data.name: Saamiyah
data.gender_notes: Saamiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Saamiyah is a name that signifies companionship and loyalty, inspired by the companions of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name Saamiyah carries the meaning “Companion of the Prophet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Saamiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody companion of the prophet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Saamiyah is associated with the concept of 'suhbah' or companionship, emphasizing the importance of righteous companions in one's spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Saamiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Companion of the Prophet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saamiyah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: سَامِيَة
in_arabic.meaning: سَامِيَة تعني الرفيعة العالية في الخُلُق والشَّرف
in_arabic.long_meaning: سَامِيَة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'سَامَ' التي تعني الرفع أو الارتفاع. يعني الاسم الشخصية التي تتميز بالخلق الرفيع والشرف العالي. وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن الأخلاق الرفيعة والصفات الحميدة.

in_urdu.name: سامیہ
in_urdu.meaning: سامیہ کا مطلب ہے بلند کردار اور شریف
in_urdu.long_meaning: سامیہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے بلند کردار، شریف اور معزز۔ یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے جہاں 'سَامَ' کا مطلب ہے بلند کرنا یا اٹھانا۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام ان نساء کے لیے منتخب کیا جاتا ہے جو اپنے کردار اور اخلاق کے لیے جانی جاتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: सामिया
in_hindi.meaning: सामिया का अर्थ है उच्च चरित्र और सम्मानित
in_hindi.long_meaning: सामिया एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है उच्च चरित्र, सम्मानित और प्रतिष्ठित। यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है जहां 'साम' का अर्थ है उठाना या ऊंचा करना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन लड़कियों के लिए चुना जाता है जो अपने अच्छे चरित्र और नैतिकता के लिए जानी जाती हैं।

in_pashto.name: سامیہ
in_pashto.meaning: سامیہ د لوړو اخلاقو او شرافت معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: سامیہ د عربي نوم دی چې د لوړو اخلاقو، شرافت او عزت معنی لري. دا نوم د عربي ريښو څخه اخیستل شوی دی چیرته چې 'سَامَ' د لوړولو یا پورته کولو معنی لري. د افغان او پښتن مسلمانو په دود کې، دا نوم د هغو ښځو لپاره غوره کیږي چې د خپل ښه کرکتر او اخلاقو لپاره پېښېږي.

in_english.name: Saamiyah
in_english.long_meaning: Saamiyah is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the root 'sām' which means 'to rise' or 'elevate'. It signifies a person of elevated character, nobility, and respect. The name reflects the importance of high moral standards and good manners in Islamic tradition. Historically, it has been used to denote individuals of high social standing and spiritual distinction.

pronunciation.hindi: सामिया का उच्चारण साह माई-या है
pronunciation.pashto: د سامیہ تلفظ سا می یه دی

data.cultural_impact: The name Saamiyah holds deep cultural significance as it is named after multiple prominent female figures in Islamic history. One of them is Saadia bint Abi Waqqas, who was a poet and the wife of Omar ibn Al-Khattab, the second caliph of Islam. Sa'd ibn Mu'adh, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad, is also believed to have had a daughter named Saamiyah. The name signifies loyalty, companionship, and a strong bond between individuals, as demonstrated by these significant figures in Islamic history.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Saamiyah represents a remarkable bond with Allah (God in Islam). It can signify the role of being a companion to Allah, dedicating one's life in His service. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) often used the term "Ashab al-Yameen," or "Companions of the Right Hand," referring to his loyal and devoted companions. Saamiyah evokes the spiritual qualities of loyalty and faithfulness in a person's relationship with Allah and the prophets. It is a name that inspires individuals to emulate the companions of the Prophet Muhammad, living a life of devotion and service to Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Companion of the Prophet" symbolizes Saamiyah is a name that signifies companionship and loyalty, inspired by the companions of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Saamiyah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of companion of the prophet.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Prophet Muhammad's companion, Umar ibn Al-Khattab, had a daughter named Saamiyah. The name Saamiyah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Saamiyah was mentioned in the Hadith literature as a variant of the name Samiha.
